description: Search Naver web, blog, cafe, news, image, video, integrated and autocomplete results. Returns exact destination URLs, titles, snippets, dates, thumbnails and vertical-specific fields. No login, cookies or proxy setup required.

containsKeyword.description: Only keep results whose title, snippet, domain, source name, cafe name or suggestion contains this text (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Result keyword filter

dateRange.description: Only return results published inside this window. Applies to blog, cafe, news, image and video modes; web and integrated modes do not support a date filter.
dateRange.title: Date range

domain.description: Only keep results from this domain (exact host or suffix, e.g. `naver.com` or `blog.naver.com`).
domain.title: Domain filter

includeAds.description: Keep paid blog placements and integrated-search ads, marked with `isAd`. (Blog and integrated modes.)
includeAds.title: Include ads

includeContent.description: Fetch the post or article body, inline images and author for blog and news results. One extra request per result; unavailable bodies are omitted. (Blog and news modes.)
includeContent.title: Include full content

includeSerpFeatures.description: Include place cards and AI briefing blocks from the integrated results page, when Naver shows them. (Integrated mode.)
includeSerpFeatures.title: Include SERP features

maxItems.description: Hard cap on all normal result records across every query (error records are extra).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Hard cap on normal result records produced by each query.
maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max items per query

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Page ceiling for paginated modes (blog, cafe, news, image, video). Collection also stops when Naver runs out of results.
maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query

mode.description: Which Naver result surface to collect.
enumTitles: Integrated SERP blocks (web, place, AI briefing, ads)
mode.title: Search mode

searchQueries.description: One or more Korean or any-language queries, e.g. `비비바` or `서울 맛집`. Duplicates and blank entries are removed. (Legacy `searchQuery` and `query` keys are still accepted.)
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Relevance or newest first. Applies to blog, cafe, news, image and video modes; web and integrated modes use Naver's default order.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

title: Naver Search Scraper Input
